name: Sword of Hope (Major Artifact)
body:
Slot none CL 16th Weight 6 lbs. Aura strong enchantment

Alignment CG Ego 25 Senses 30 ft. (vision and hearing) Int 18 Wis 10 Cha 18 Communication speech/telepathy (Celestial, Common)

POWERS

The sword can cast create food and water, protection from evil, and cure serious wounds 3 times per day.

This silvery blade is a +5 transformative bastard sword. Any evil character trying to wield the blade suffers the effects of burning disarm (5d4 hp of damage), in addition to taking a negative level as long as she holds it.

While bearing the weapon, the wielder is immune to all mind-affecting effects that rely on negative emotions. When in combat, the wielder is also constantly under the effect of sanctuary. If the sword scores a critical hit, the wielder can attempt to improve the foe’s attitude as with the Entreating Critical feat. Five times per day, the sword can also be used to cast good hope or soothing word on an ally by touching the ally with the edge of the blade.

DESTRUCTION

The Sword of Hope melts into a dull mass of useless metal if used by a good-aligned wielder to kill a hundred good-aligned creatures of its own free will (not under any duress, blackmail, or enchantment effect).
